mainEntity.name: Do you support older Apache OFBiz releases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We support systems on older releases, review the gap to the current one, and plan the upgrade around your custom code.

mainEntity.name: Can you take over a system another vendor built?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We start from your code and environments, then our engineers learn and document the system before taking over support.

mainEntity.name: Who is HotWax Systems the right partner for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Companies where Apache OFBiz runs a core process such as orders, inventory, warehouse, manufacturing, or procurement. If a packaged product fits you better, we will tell you.

mainEntity.name: Our code is heavily customized. Is that a problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Customized Apache OFBiz systems are what we support every day.

mainEntity.name: Do we have to upgrade before you support us?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We stabilize the system you run today, then recommend whether and when to upgrade. The decision stays yours.

mainEntity.name: Will you replace our in-house developers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We work alongside your team and add the Apache OFBiz depth it is missing.
You do. No vendor lock-in. The code, the data, and the roadmap stay yours.

mainEntity.name: Do you support Apache OFBiz in the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or your own servers, including the DevOps work that comes with it.
Yes. See our Moqui development, consulting and support services.
